ops.title: Fence Trunk queue reads to the indexed pull-request head
ops.description: Actual v2 GET /pull-requests exposes sha, but nativeapi.trunkPull currently drops it and classifies admission from isCurrentlySubmittedToQueue and queueEntry alone. ccx status head is GitHub-authoritative, not Trunk-indexed evidence. Root requires stale/unknown queue evidence to refuse owned publication; the temporary manual recovery envelope explicitly compares raw Trunk sha, GitHub head and the Git lease. Preserve that invariant in the native client using its existing current-head snapshot. No live stale-index mismatch has been captured; the missing field/fence is source-proven. Keep this separate from merged auth567 and preserve all queue/provider guards.

ops.text: Mismatched or missing indexed Trunk sha yields unknown/refusal for a current-head mutation.
Matching current-head not-submitted records retain not-queued behavior; queued/inconsistent records still refuse.
Current-head metadata batching and legacy Graphite behavior remain intact; CI grades meaningful state-boundary cases.
